title: MicrosoftDocs/memdocs answers 404, but doc-lookup-sources.md says it is archived and four live sources still point into it
goal: Through /kb-refresh of agents/doc-lookup-sources and agents/doc-change-detection: the facts that rest on MicrosoftDocs/memdocs (that it is archived, its licence terms, its redirection files, a ConfigMgr page's commit resolving in it) say what holds now that the repository answers 404 on the API, on github.com and for raw files, or become [UNK] with a _gaps.md entry; the four live rows S2196, S-pcy7cqea, S-rgpijsmb and S-yuwxbqz3 are marked dead with their last Wayback capture by factdiff.py dead, or superseded where a live successor states the same; the repro then reports no dead fact.
